description: Plays a .wav file straight off disk, reading it a piece at a time rather than loading the whole file

params.text: Starts playback; pressed again while the sample runs it restarts, stops or pauses it, whichever Play Retrig Mode is set to. Its light is green playing, yellow re-buffering, red on error
Turns looping on and off; with it on, the sample begins again at the end instead of stopping

inputs.text: A rising edge above 0.5V does what pressing PLAY does
While this jack is above 0.5V the LOOP button's setting is reversed, so looping runs when the button is off and stops when it is on

outputs.text: The left channel of the sample, 5V peak, or the whole of a mono file
The right channel of the sample, 5V peak, or the whole of a mono file
5V for as long as the sample is playing, and 0V while it is stopped or paused
A 10ms 5V pulse each time the sample reaches its end, and each time playback is restarted or stopped

notes: Nothing plays until a file is chosen: right-click the panel and use Load Sample... to pick a .wav.
The waveform drawing and the message strip above it are one display each, not controls; the play head, the buffer state and any file error are reported there.
menu: Play Retrig Mode: Retrigger, Stop, Pause — sets what a play trigger does while the sample is already running
Waveform Zoom — sets how much of the recent audio the waveform drawing covers
Playback Buffer Threshold — sets how full the buffer has to be before playback starts, as a share of the buffer; lower starts sooner, higher survives a slow disk
Max Buffer Size — sets the memory the module may use for the sample, from 1MB to 128MB; a sample that fits is held whole and needs no further disk reads
Buffer Strategy: Fill to threshold, Fill completely — chooses whether reading from disk stops at the threshold or carries on until the buffer is full
Startup Delay (sec) — holds off any disk access for this many seconds after the patch loads, so several players can be made to load one after another
Load Sample... — opens a file chooser for the .wav file this module plays
